snippet.title: ECC: REDLINE | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing ECC: REDLINE, a competitive FPS built around extreme sports from NetEase Games.

Welcome to ECC (Extreme Circuit Championship), a new-generation tactical survival tournament.

Enter the Circuit, Own the Edge.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5268340/ECC_REDLINE/

#ECCREDLINE #ECC

Follow the official channels for more updates:
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@ECCREDLINE
X: https://x.com/ECCREDLINE
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ECCREDLINE
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eccredline/
